purpose: Complete two fresh-state controls and audit saved I02H results; never rerun or change existing cases.
material_qualification: Assumed engineering-to-true conversion of NASA STAGS points; stress/strain convention not established by the reviewed primary pages. Sensitivity input, not a calibrated 767 material card.

additional_diagnostics.ctoa_time_comparison: Compare at equal discrete extension, not equal row number; diagnostic, not a predeclared acceptance gate.
additional_diagnostics.whole_history_kinetic_ratio: Report maximum KE/IE only after work exceeds 1% of maximum absolute external work; peak-only gate does not imply quasi-static propagation.
